workflow_edits:
- name: Build the fresh native base and original package pairs
      - name: Checkout exact complete496 original native-base public bytes
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        timeout-minutes: 2
        with:
          ref: f71f985f411fc6cc5e9b9832a1001119311d8c5a
          path: native-base-public496
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Seed fresh complete496 native-base cache before unchanged authentication
        timeout-minutes: 4
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git -C "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/native-base-public496" rev-parse HEAD)" = f71f985f411fc6cc5e9b9832a1001119311d8c5a
          printf '%s  %s\n' '448e618c54b3018ce7a104ea5fdaf0d1f1e6be34087c9a68e4114acf14a65546' "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/native-base-public496/seed.py" '846b4e70a4416935bd77449b4e5891363b1cab5467e347a7cedbd78fedb717db' "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/native-base-public496/index.json" 'a8b6ed8971a38089a4499dcec605477c4e48d7a47c3de485d205f6a44678b898' "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/scripts/ci/native_arm.py" | sha256sum --check
          python3 -I -B "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/native-base-public496/seed.py" \
            --lock "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/scripts/ci/inputs.lock.json" \
            --cache "$RUNNER_TEMP/native-base-public496-cache"
      - name: Build the fresh native base and original package pairs
